title: ADV-1 advisory recommendation
description: The roundtable's answer to an advisory request. It is a proposal for human review, never a command: requiresHumanApproval is fixed true, and the original request's defaultChoice applies if nobody approves in time. `process` records how the recommendation was reached, so a reviewer can tell a real majority from a fallback to the default; tools/validate.py re-derives the outcome from `votes` and `process` and rejects a recommendation they do not support.

recommendation.description: The options[].id the roundtable proposes. Always one of the request's options: the roundtable chooses among what the requester enumerated and cannot invent an action.

votes.description: Valid votes only, keyed by agent role, e.g. 'Safety Officer'. A role whose vote was missing or invalid appears under process.abstained instead.

basis.description: unanimous / plurality: the vote winner is recommended. tie-default: first place was tied. no-quorum-default: no more than half of the participants cast a valid vote. safety-block-default: the vote winner was flagged unsafe by the safety critic. The last three always recommend the request's defaultChoice.

participants.description: Every role seated for the session. Each appears exactly once in votes or in abstained.

notes.description: Process events a reviewer may want to know about, e.g. a role whose call failed in an earlier round.
